svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TLE92466ED: Simplified application circuit
svg.desc: Schematic of the TLE92466ED simplified application circuit: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 polarized-capacitor 100 µF, C2 capacitor 100 nF, C3 capacitor 100 nF, C4 capacitor 100 nF, C5 capacitor 100 nF, R1 resistor 10 kΩ, L0 solenoid, L1 solenoid, L2 solenoid, L3 solenoid, L4 solenoid, L5 solenoid, D0 diode, D1 diode, D2 diode, D3 diode, D4 diode, D5 diode, C10 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C11 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C12 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C13 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C14 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C15 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C20 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C21 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C22 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C23 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C24 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF, C25 capacitor 4.7 nF to 10 nF; the MCU wires carry the port hooks GpioRead(CtrlPin::Fault), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Drv0), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Drv1), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Enable), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Reset), Transfer().
svg.text: Figure 26 of the data sheet with all six channels: each solenoid hangs from the switched load supply to its LOAD pin, with its freewheeling diode from the FWD pin back to that supply and 4.7
to 10 nF on LOAD and FWD. The MCU drives SPI, RESN, EN, DRV0, DRV1 and CLK and reads FAULTN through a 10 kΩ pull-up to VIO. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it.
